topics.label: Causation
topics.description: But-for causation, material contribution, scope of duty, and intervening acts.

topics.label: Remoteness
topics.description: Reasonable foreseeability, scope of liability, and kind of damage.

topics.label: Product Liability

topics.label: Vicarious Liability
topics.description: Employment relationship, close connection, and institutional liability.

topics.label: Economic Loss

topics.label: Psychiatric Harm

topics.label: Private Nuisance

topics.label: Defamation
topics.description: Publication, serious harm, defences, and remedies.

jurisdiction_guidance: Use UK court labels, UK institutions, and England-and-Wales civil litigation terminology where source context supports it.
Avoid implying BAILII clearance; this pack's committed samples come from The National Archives Find Case Law.

topic_hints.duty_of_care: Include Caparo-style foreseeability, proximity, fairness, or assumption of responsibility facts.
topic_hints.occupiers_liability: Include control of premises, entrant status, hazard, warning, and statutory duty context.
topic_hints.product_liability: Include product, alleged defect, manufacturer/supplier role, warning, and injury facts.
topic_hints.vicarious_liability: Include relationship status and close-connection facts.
topic_hints.economic_loss: Distinguish pure economic loss from physical damage or consequential loss.

course_guidance: Use common-law tort vocabulary and keep UK-specific labels only when source context supports them.
Frame questions for general issue spotting rather than UK professional qualification preparation.

generic_common_law_tort.notes: Common-law issue-spotting profile backed by comparator sample records; not professional-exam preparation.

validation.topic_coverage: Each record maps to at least one UK Tort taxonomy topic.

quality_checks: All records include non-empty capped text excerpts
